newsitem.title: USA: IMM currencies end higher, most off earlier highs.
newsitem.headline: IMM currencies end higher, most off earlier highs.

text.p: July 18 - IMM currencies ended up but most contracts were off from earlier peak. Sept yen fell from $0.008757 high in thin, choppy trade, but still closed up, trader said. French bank affiliate bought 1,000 Sept Canada on the close, floor sources said. Traders noted offers on the close in Sept Aussie. French budget, Humphrey-Hawkins on tap next week.
